fact: The Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services reported on 4 September 2025 that its leadership estimated a budget for the operations of the Access to Information Commission, which it calls a parastatal facing operating challenges; the amount was not given and the budget is estimated, not voted.

The FY 2024/25 budget performance report lists the Access for Information Commission among the Public Administration agencies whose allocations are reported against IFMIS actuals; the report prints no date, so its published date is used.

The Minister of Information's 6 September 2023 conference paper lists the Information Commission (IC) as one of six parastatals under the Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services.
